scenarios.requirement: Trema tomentosa/tomentosum with missing identity is visible in ordinary flagged review, summary and reconcile_candidates.
Trema orientalis/orientale with missing identity is visible in ordinary flagged review, summary and reconcile_candidates.
An ordinary plausible non-ending spelling candidate with unknown identity stays reviewable without a Latin-ending label.
Unknown, ambiguous, incomparable and distinct-ID states remain distinguishable, with original names and alternatives preserved.
A missing tree target does not become an automatic nearby-species match; pending alternatives do not reserve or consume tree tips.
Default apply excludes all pending review-only candidates and leaves the intended data/tree identities unchanged.
Newly exposed candidates cannot be applied unintentionally through include_flagged; existing documented behavior is regression-tested.
Explicit accept/reject/skip actions are traceable and affect only the selected pair; alternatives remain consistent.
Legacy saved reconciliation objects and existing flagged/fuzzy/identity_candidates modes retain defined compatible behavior.
All five original #139 distinct-ID pairs remain excluded from automatic application.
A valid same-identity cross-genus synonym remains distinguishable from ambiguous, unplaced or conflicting-source records, with no relaxed automatic policy.
